verdict.rationale: Phoenix ships an official npm CLI, `@arizeai/phoenix-cli`, whose `setup` command lets a coding agent configure tracing from an app's root directory. It also has an official `arize-phoenix serve` command and a documented 'Run via CLI' self-hosting path, so an official CLI clearly exists and is pitched at agent-driven workflows. missing for 10: a CLI command reference showing scope beyond setup/serve (e.g. querying traces, datasets or experiments from the terminal), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI working as described.
